turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to organize my meeting notes from the quarterly review. Did I save the draft to the cloud?
I don't have access to your cloud storage directly, Alan. Did you name it something specific?

Right, sorry. It's called 'Q2_Review_Draft'. Anyway, the main takeaway was about Balázs Horváth. He really pushed back on our current KPI structure. I'm starting to agree with him that we need to shift from velocity-based KPIs to usage-frequency indicators.
Noted. That's a significant shift in how you measure success.
Yeah. It's hard to get people on board, but the data supports it. Oh, by the way, can you check if the new monitor arm I ordered is shipping?
I can't check external order statuses. You might want to check your email for the tracking link.
Good point. I'll do that. Just wanted to make sure you had that context on Balázs's view for later.
I've made a note of your preference regarding the metric evolution.
